thread:
deploy-bot: PAGER -> SEV:critical: model pin drift detected in prod (us-east-1). Symptoms: 502s on text-gen, increased latency, tokenization errors reported. paging @matt.green oncall

matt.green: on it. putting myself on-call. any immediate mitigation suggestions? :telephone_receiver:

sophia.kumar: I see a spike in error rate ~3.2% starting 2026-03-17T01:09Z. Canary rollout completed ~01:05Z. Looks like new model version pulled a wrong weightset alias.

devon: confirmed: model alias "rwdl-model-v3" resolved to weightset sha mismatch compared to pinned commit. tokenizer config mismatch also present (vocab_version: 9 != 8). suspect artifact promotion bug.

matt.green: ok, kill switch ready? Feature flag `model_autopromote` still true for this deployment group. flipping to false now.

priya.shah: +1. runbook step 2: trigger immediate fallback to previous pinned model variant. matt, want me to execute rollback?

matt.green: please. priya, execute rollback to pin `sha: a1b2c3d4` and verify routing. use the hot-revert playbook.

priya.shah: running command now:
```
./infra/runbooks/revert_model.sh --model rwdl-model-v3 --pin a1b2c3d4 --region us-east-1 --force
```

priya.shah: revert initiated. hitting the API to drain new instances and redirect traffic. estimated cutover ~2m.

niko: watching logs. tokenizer errors dropping in the last 30s but still some stale caches in edge nodes. purging KV cache for embeddings service in us-east-1:
```
POST /cache/purge?service=embeddings&region=us-east-1
```

cs-bot: Customer impact: Notified CS triage. Affected customers: 12 sessions with degraded responses; 2 support tickets opened (IDs: #4532, #4533).

sophia.kumar: metric check: latency back to normal, error rate trending to baseline 0.12%. rolling window shows revert successful at 01:13Z.

matt.green: good. leaving a temporary kill switch and opening a follow-up. tagging eng-platform and release to investigate artifact promotion pipeline.

devon: quick postmortem notes in thread: found race where promoted artifact alias was updated before all CI validators completed; bad weightset pushed. tokenizer artifact resolved to newer vocab unexpectedly. adding stronger gating.

matt.green: handoff to daytime oncall @niko in 25m. I'll add incident ticket and start RCA doc. priority: fix promotion gating, add post-publish checksum verification, and ensure tokenizer/version pinning in deploy manifest.

niko: acknowledged. I'll monitor the next hour and confirm edge cache drains.

priya.shah: filing post-incident action items. Assigning: eng-platform (promote-gate), infra (cache-invalidation), release (artifact-verification).

cs-bot: Customer communication draft available in #customer-communications. Suggested wording: "We experienced a transient degradation due to a model release mismatch; service has been reverted and is stable. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."

sophia.kumar: closing the pager in 10m if no regression. great job team. :clap:

matt.green: closing notes: no data exfil, no config rollback required beyond feature flag and revert. RCA to be posted in confluence under INC-1779999999."
